final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink IREF (10 uA)
M8  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=2 m=1
* tail current source (20 uA)
M5  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=2 m=2
* NMOS input pair (vinp = non-inverting, on output side)
M1  n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=4
M2  out1  vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=4
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=0.5 m=1
M4  out1  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=0.5 m=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (120 uA)
M6  vout  out1  vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=0.5 m=12
M7  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=2 m=12
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  out1  nc    2.4k
Cc  nc    vout  1.2p
.ends
